queries.scope: Find official Vadodara rural/urban records and urban city-survey parcel references.
queries.result: Gujarati Vadodara district government page confirms Revenue Department ROR services for rural and urban land and points to AnyRoR; survey number, khata and entry details are available. It does not claim public full vector geometry.
queries.executionMethod: Native-language search and official Gujarati district page review.

queries.query: Vadodara official urban city survey property card cadastral map e-Milkat Gujarat
queries.scope: Verify official city survey parcel lookups and whether vector geometry is public.
queries.result: Gujarat e-Milkat is the official urban property-card inquiry portal with city survey, ward, survey and sheet selectors. Public search/record access does not itself provide a full parcel polygon response.
queries.executionMethod: Official portal and government service-page review.

portals.name: Gujarat Revenue Department AnyRoR and Settlement Commissioner e-Milkat
portals.observation: Official Gujarat Revenue urban/rural record lookup. Survey number/khata lookups are records; full feature geometry was not retrieved.

requests.observation: Official district land-record page links AnyRoR for urban/rural record lookup. e-Milkat provides urban property-card lookup; its disclaimer says online information is informational and not an official copy. No anonymous full-polygon response was verified.
Official urban property-card search page provides city-survey, ward, survey and sheet selectors; informational-use disclaimer.
